title: CSCI 351 — Data Communications and Networks
subject: Networks and Cloud Computing
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and distinguish the five Internet protocol layers (physical, data link, network, transport, application) and their respective responsibilities.
Explain how TCP establishes a reliable, ordered byte stream using sequence numbers, acknowledgments, and state transitions.
Apply graph-based modeling and discrete event simulation concepts to analyze network routing and packet flow.
